title: tpt-log.toml
description: Configuration for tpt-microlog. Every key is optional; TPT_LOG_* environment variables override file values.

service.description: Logical service name, attached to every entry when `enrichment` is on.

endpoint.description: Base URL / address for the chosen backend.

api_key.description: Secret token (Datadog DD-API-KEY, Splunk HEC token, Bearer token...). Prefer TPT_LOG_API_KEY over committing it.

grpc_endpoint.description: gRPC target in `host:port` form (OpenTelemetry Collector default port is 4317).

file_path.description: Local JSONL file for the `file` backend.

file_rotation_bytes.description: Rotate the file backend above this many bytes.

file_rotation_seconds.description: Rotate the file backend after this many seconds.

file_rotations.description: Number of rotated files to keep.

aws_region.description: CloudWatch region (or the AWS_REGION env var).

aws_session_token.description: STS session token for temporary credentials.

aws_auto_create_stream.description: Create the log group/stream on first send when missing.

datadog_metrics.description: Also ship `metric()` entries through the Datadog Metrics API.

body_mode.description: Generic HTTP body encoding: plain JSON (default) or opt-in zstd.

tcp_ack.description: Ask the TCP receiver for a 1-byte ack after each frame.

ca_cert.description: PEM bundle used to verify server TLS certificates.

proxy.description: HTTP(S) proxy URL for all network backends.

failover.description: With fanout: stop at the first successful backend instead of sending to all.

preset.description: Named configuration preset applied on load.

batch_size.description: Flush a batch at this many entries.

memory_limit_bytes.description: Flush once buffered bytes exceed this.

queue_full_policy.description: Behavior when the ingestion queue is full.

wal_max_size_bytes.description: WAL size cap in bytes (oldest dropped first).

wal_dead_letter_replays.description: Move a WAL file to `wal/dead/` after this many failed replays.

durability.description: `wal-first` writes every batch to the WAL before the first delivery attempt.

shutdown_timeout_ms.description: Hard budget for shutdown(); leftovers spill to the WAL.

enrichment.description: Attach hostname / PID / service / env vars to every entry.

enrich_env_vars.description: Environment variable names captured into enriched entries.

sample_rate.description: Fraction of entries delivered. WARN and above are never sampled.

filter_tags.description: Drop entries carrying any of these `tag=value` pairs.

filter_regex.description: Drop entries whose message matches this regex.

redact_keys.description: Metadata keys (case-insensitive) whose values are always masked.

redact_patterns.description: Regexes masked in messages and string metadata.

redact_builtin.description: Enable built-in detectors: email, card, SSN, JWT, bearer token, AWS key.

dedup_window_ms.description: Fold identical entries (same level + message) seen within this many ms into the first, adding `repeat_count`. 0 = off.

rate_limit_per_sec.description: Routine (below WARN) entries allowed per second. 0 = unlimited.

adaptive_sampling.description: Sample routine entries harder as the ingestion queue fills. WARN+ is never sampled.

adaptive_sampling_floor.description: Lowest sampling rate adaptive sampling falls to.

flight_recorder_size.description: Keep this many recent low-severity entries and ship them only when an ERROR/FATAL follows. 0 = off.

flight_recorder_max_level.description: Entries at or below this level go to the flight recorder.

daily_budget_entries.description: Entries per UTC day; sampling tightens automatically to stay within it. WARN+ is never limited. 0 = no budget.

self_metrics_interval_ms.description: Emit the logger's own health as metrics every N ms. 0 = off.

wal_frame_newline.description: Use newline-delimited base64 framing for the WAL.
